text: 第一处公开瑕疵。请观察不规则结构与周围内雕文字之间的关系。照片的文件哈希能检查它是否与公开存档一致；比对实物，还需要位置、角度和见证过程。内雕文字也提供观察时的参照。请把瑕疵的轮廓与周围环境一起看，而不是只记住一个孤立的亮点。

text: The first public flaw. Observe the irregular structure in relation to the surrounding engraving. A file hash checks that the photograph matches the public archive. Comparing the physical object requires positions, viewing angles and a witnessed procedure. The engraving also provides a visual reference. Look at the flaw’s outline together with its surroundings, rather than remembering only an isolated bright point.

text: 第二处公开瑕疵。复制图像容易，复现内部结构、深度以及多点之间的空间关系更困难。多处瑕疵共同提供可比对的物理特征，而不是依靠一张照片宣告绝对不可复制。实际检验会改变观察角度与光线，检查同一组特征是否持续对应。

text: The second public flaw. Copying an image is easy. Reproducing internal structures, depth and relationships between several points is harder. Multiple flaws provide physical features for comparison, rather than a photograph proving absolute impossibility of replication. A physical examination changes the viewing angle and lighting to check whether the same group of features continues to correspond.

text: 第三处公开瑕疵。不完美留下了真实世界的痕迹。作为一种艺术表达，它也映照人的缺憾、脆弱和不可替代的经历。一个存在值得被记住，不是因为它毫无缺陷，而是因为它确曾存在，有自己的故事。这是一种关于存在与记忆的表达；照片的证据作用和这层艺术含义，可以同时被看见。

text: The third public flaw. Imperfection leaves traces of the real world. As an artistic reading, it reflects human limitations, vulnerability and irreplaceable experience. A life can deserve remembrance with all its imperfections, because it existed and had a story of its own. This is an expression about existence and memory. The evidential role of the photograph and its artistic meaning can both remain visible.
